posts.name: CharType
posts.cooked:
I currently have two pairs in the Sentinels multiverse that I ship. The first is Beacon aka Young Legacy x Bunker. They're part of the same team and Bunker's always looked up to Finest Legacy. I could see a romance there.

The second is The Idealist x Potential Sidekick from Spite's deck. This is depending on relative ages. I'm guessing Potential Sidekick is around 15 at the time of the main storyline? I'm shipping this based on what seems to be common idealism and desire to be a hero, the fact that Potential Sidekick has worked with The Sentinels before as seen on Human Shield, and the fact that they appear to be the only heroes around that age in the main storyline..

So, what characters in the Sentinels multiverse do you ship?

Cosmitron/Swift Bot. Those two have had some wacky adventures, and they're able to bridge the hero/villain gap with their shared disdain for human incompetence. 

Also, Baron Blade and Maria Helena: they both have a flair for the dramatic,  know how to inspire followers, and are interested in traditional villainy things. But little does Blade know that La Capitan eventually breaks up with him and starts seeing Blade's father! Oh, the drama!
